label: REALITY
line1: Har muskurata chehra apna nahi hota,
line2: waqt aane par yeh sabaq khud mil jata hai.

label: TANHAI
line2: sab se gehra dard hota hai.

label: SABR
line1: Jo cheez der se mil rahi hai,
line2: shayad Allah use behtar bana kar de raha hai.

label: DEEP LINES
line2: woh bas har baat ka jawab dena chhod dete hain.

label: MOHABBAT
line1: Kuch log zindagi mein sabaq ban kar aate hain,
line2: aur hum unhein qismat samajh baithte hain.

label: HIMMAT
line2: sab se mazboot dobara khada hota hai.

label: ZINDAGI
line1: Jo har waqt sab ke liye haazir rahe,
line2: uski qadar sab se kam hoti hai.
